messages:
mira: BetaCorp reported intermittent "dimension mismatch" errors in production after we enabled per-route adaptive batching last night. They see:

beta-support-bot: "error: dimension_mismatch, expected=1536 got=768, request_id=beta-44a"

mira: customer says errors happen ~1-2% of calls, spikes during high load windows. Their consumer panics when it gets 768-length vectors.

tony: can you grab a failing request's raw headers and payload? Also check which model variant was selected via X-Model-Selected.

mira: pasted minimal failing payload they captured:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1536","input":["x","y"],"batching":{"enabled":true}}' -H 'X-Request-ID: beta-44a' -i
```

mira: failing response they captured (headers + body): 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Model-Selected: rwd-embed-768-compat
X-Route-Trace: trc-5f2b
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"dimension_mismatch","expected":1536,"got":768,"request_id":"beta-44a"}
```

sophia: if X-Model-Selected shows the 768 variant, that's routing fallback. We have an autoswitch that will route to lower-dim compatible models under capacity constraints.

tony: we should confirm the trace. mira can you pull trc-5f2b from Console > Traces and check the timeline (model_select, batching_wait, exec)?

mira: trace attached: model_select chose rwd-embed-768-compat at 1901248123. Reason tag: fallback_capacity_pressure. Batching wait is small (~10ms).

sophia: that matches. Two problems: 1) batching combined requests that requested 1536 vectors but were routed to 768 model; 2) the runtime didn't validate final output dimension vs requested model and returned a soft error instead of strict failure.

tony: immediate mitigations: - pin route for BetaCorp to model=rwd-embed-1536 via Console; - disable autoswitch fallback on that customer route; - add client-side quick-fix: if you get dimension_mismatch, retry with force_model param.

mira: BetaCorp confirmed pinning fixed the issue for now.

sophia: longer term: eng-ml should add pre-return validation in the batcher: when mixing requests that target different implied dims, either split batches by selected model or fail the batch with a 409 so callers can retry with force_model. Also emit metric embeddings.dim_mismatch_count{route,requested_model,selected_model}.

tony: agree. Create ENG-ML ticket and assign priority P2. I can put together a small patch to enforce strict_dim_check by default for routes that opt-in.

deploy-bot: config-deploy success for /routes/embeddings at 1901248200 :white_check_mark:

mira: billing question from BetaCorp: will they be charged for returned 768 vectors when they requested 1536? Billing-bot: we'll open BILL ticket to investigate and potentially credit if misbilling occurred.

billing-bot: Created BILL-4802 for BetaCorp possible misbilling; tentative action: issue provisional credit if >500 affected requests.

tony: observability notes: console should surface a small panel in Routes > embeddings showing recent dim_mismatch traces and a filter to jump to trace ids. Also we should include X-Trace-Span and span ids in response headers for better cross-correlation.

sophia: for troubleshooting KB add these repro steps: 1) reproduce single request with batching disabled and ?trace=true to collect X-Model-Selected and X-Route-Trace, 2) if mismatch, pin model using force_model or Console, 3) attach trace id + sample payload to ENG ticket. Example curl we recommend:

```bash
curl -v -X POST 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings?trace=true' \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n -H 'X-Request-ID: beta-debug-1' \n -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1536","input":["hello world"]}'
```

Then check response headers: X-Model-Selected and X-Route-Trace and save the trace.

tony: follow-ups we bumped: ENG-ML-924 (batcher guard + metric), CONSOLE-310 (routes panel), BILL-4802 (billing review).

mira: marking support loop closed after BetaCorp confirmed stability. Leaving ENG/BILL tickets open.

sophia: adding one more: please add a rate metric for "requests_pinned_to_model" so PMs can see how many routes are pinned to avoid autoswitch.

billing-bot: BetaCorp notified: "We've pinned your route and started a billing review. We'll follow up with any credits." :white_check_mark:

mira: closing thread. Attach trace ids and sample payloads to ENG tickets.
